articles.title: I’m a Doctor With Stage 4 Cancer. Even I Struggled to Get My Insurance to Pay
articles.summary: Without insurance, emergency department or urgent care visits are completely unaffordable for the average person. In 2021, the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) estimated the average cost in the United States for a “treat and release” Emergency Department visit is $750. The bill could be much, much higher, even thousands of dollars, depending on tests performed and treatment administered. articles.summary: The Russian exclave of Kaliningrad on the Baltic Sea has the potential to become a flashpoint with NATO as recent maritime security incidents between Russia and Ukraine bring renewed attention to the territory nestled between two NATO members. articles.title: How to Have a More Sustainable Black Friday, According to Experts
articles.summary: Black Friday is here—holding the promise of good deals and the unofficial start of the holiday shopping season. But if you plan to shop the sales, take the time to think about what you really need —and what you plan to give. Americans spent $10 billion dollars on unwanted gifts in 2024. And last year, 65% of consumers reported returning a holiday gift, while 54% admitted to regifting an unwanted item.
